events.text:
I made the separate blocker list as **T-407** (in review for Adi, Nelbin and Bharath). T-226 stays blocked, because the app validated earlier is the wrong kind of Zoom app for the seat.

**What I checked on the live centre today:**
- **The validated app:** it's "Tantra Centre", a Server-to-Server app. Zoom only runs its meeting kit (the Meeting SDK) from a "General App", so Tantra Centre can't be the seat.
- **Seat credentials:** none are saved on the Live Control page.
- **Poll permissions:** Tantra Centre still lacks all 5 poll permissions (scopes). Without them no polls can be created ahead, so none can run live.
- **The seat itself:** it has never connected to the centre.
- **The script:** Day 1, 2 and 3 have no chat, link or poll items yet.
- **Co-hosts:** the list is empty.

The next session is meeting 88135386601, Day 1 on Wed 14 Oct at 11:00 ET.

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| Separate task with the updated blocker list (F-532a89ae) | Done: T-407, every item checked live today |
| Meeting SDK app's Client ID and Secret saved on Live Control | Blocked on Adi (Zoom sign-in) |
| 5 poll permissions added to Tantra Centre | Blocked on Adi (same sign-in) |
| Zoom's meeting kit downloaded and the seat app built | Claude, once the app above exists |
| Test meeting (chat, links, live poll, mute and video lock, co-host) | Claude, with Adi hosting, after the three items above |
| Day 1 to 3 chat, links and polls written | Bhaskar (wording), Adi (polls) |
| Co-host emails added | Nelbin |
| T-226 status set and note acknowledged | Done: blocked, F-532a89ae acknowledged |

**Needed from Adi (one Zoom sign-in, two steps):**
1. At https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create, create General App "Tantra Live Control" (Features, Embed, Meeting SDK on, do not publish). If it already exists, just open it. Paste its Client ID and Client Secret into the Seat credentials card at https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/control and press Save.
2. On marketplace.zoom.us, open Manage, then Tantra Centre, then Scopes. Add these 5:
   - meeting:write:poll:admin
   - meeting:update:poll:admin
   - meeting:delete:poll:admin
   - meeting:read:list_polls:admin
   - meeting:read:list_poll_results:admin
